shortDescription: The FTSE 100 Index dropped 10 points or 0.09 percent on Tuesday to close at 10812 points.Losses were led by Computacenter (-5.09%), Smith & Nephew (-4.56%) and GlaxoSmithKline (-2.48%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Antofagasta (4.69%), Glencore (4.05%) and Weir (3.52%).

children: The FTSE 100 Index dropped 10 points or 0.09 percent on Tuesday to close at 10812 points.

title: The FTSE 100 Index Closes 0.09% Lower
